name: krack Jack
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Refined Oils (Palm and Palmolein), Sugar (17%), Raising Agents [503 (ii), 500 (ii), 341(i)], Invert Sugar Syrup, Iodised Salt (0.9%), Yeast, Acidity Regulators [270, 296], Flour Treatment Agents [223, 1101(ii), 1100(i)], Emulsifier of Vegetable Origin [Diacetyltartaric and Fatty Acid Esters of Glycerol]. Contains added flavours (artificial flavouring substances - vanilla, butter).
